data.name: Malayun
data.gender_notes: Malayun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Malayun is derived from the Arabic word 'ma'l-a' (young) and 'ayyun' (elephant). It symbolizes strength and power in youth. The name Malayun carries the meaning “Young Elephant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Malayun usually hope their child will grow to embody young elephant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Malayun is a name that inspires courage and resilience. It is a reminder of the strength and power that lies within each of us, especially during the formative years of our lives.
data.etymology: Malayun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young Elephant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malayun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ملايون
in_arabic.long_meaning: الملايون: هو مصطلح يُشير إلى الملايين، والمليارديرات، والعظيمين الذين يمتلكون ثروة كبيرة، ويحظى بسمعة طيبة، ويحترمون في المجتمع الإسلامي، ومن أصل قديم يعود إلى الفارسية، ومن أصل معرب إلى الأрабية، والملايون يُستخدم كمصدر لوصف الأشخاص الذين يمتلكون ثروة كبيرة، كما يُستخدم في القرآن الكريم في بعض الآيات، ويعتبر مصطلحًا شائعًا في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: ملایون
in_urdu.meaning: ملینوں کی تعداد میں، عظیم وغنی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملایون: یہ لفظ عربی زبان کے لفظ "ملایون" سے ماخوذ ہے جو «ملینوں کی تعداد میں» یا «عظیم وغنی» کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اس کا استعمال اکثر ثروہم کی وجہ سے عظیم شخصیات کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ قرآن میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے

in_hindi.name: मलायुन
in_hindi.meaning: लाखों की संख्या में रहने वाले लोग, बेशुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: मलायुन: यह शब्द अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'लाखों की संख्या में रहने वाले लोग' या 'बेशुमार'। इस शब्द का उपयोग अक्सर धनी और प्रसिद्ध लोगों के लिए किया जाता है। यह शब्द कुरान में भी प्रयोग किया गया है।

data.cultural_impact: The name Malayun reflects the fusion of various cultural influences, as it is a combination of Arabic and Malay roots. In Malay culture, the elephant is a revered animal and is believed to represent power, wisdom, and good fortune. Thus, the name Malayun evokes images of young strength and power, reminiscent of the majestic elephant. In the Islamic context, the name's Arabic origin emphasizes youth's significance in continuous learning and striving for self-improvement and spiritual growth.

The name's Arabic origins emphasize the importance of knowledge and wisdom. The young elephant symbol represents the individual's potential power, strength, and wisdom to accomplish great things for the sake of Allah. Just as an elephant is a symbol of strength and intelligence in Malay culture, Malayun reminds us to develop our intellect, emotional intelligence, and physical strength in our spiritual journey. Just as an elephant's power is harnessed for good, Malayun invites individuals to harness their potential for the greater good and to strive for excellence in their daily lives.
